schedules.name: NSE cash equity delivery via Zerodha
schedules.notes: HISTORICAL delivery rates for 2016-01-01 to 2017-06-30. Evidenced from stored documents: STT 0.1% each side (NSE circulars 2016/2023/2024/2026: no change), zero delivery brokerage (Zerodha, from 1 Dec 2015), the NSE transaction rate and the dates it changed (Zerodha bulletins Apr 2023, Apr 2024, Oct 2024; NSE circular Mar 2026), stamp duty 0.015% on the buy side from 1 Jul 2020 (NSE), SEBI fee Rs 10/crore and GST 18% (Zerodha and NSE pages, undated: read on the retrieval date), DP fee Rs 13 per debit before and after 1 Oct 2024 (Zerodha bulletin). Before GST (1 Jul 2017) service tax applied to the exchange fee; it is NOT modelled here (about 0.0005 bp of turnover). Stamp duty before 1 Jul 2020 was set by each state: the uniform 0.015% is applied as a CONSERVATIVE assumption. The 0.00345% is the 'old' rate before Apr 2023; when it began is not stated. The DP fee for these years is not evidenced: Rs 13 assumed.
